# GSAP

The portfolio uses GSAP 3.12.5 and ScrollTrigger, the same version previously loaded from jsDelivr.
The files are hosted locally so navigation does not depend on an external script request.

Sources:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

The original copyright and license notices remain in both files.
